question: A pond has been dug at the Indian Statistical Institute as an inverted truncated pyramid with a square base (see figure below). The depth of the pond is $6$m. The square at the bottom has side length $2$m and the top square has side length $8$m. Water is filled in at a rate of $\frac{19}{3}$ cubic meters per hour. At what rate is the water level rising exactly $1$ hour after the water started to fill the pond?
